subject: [hw] DEC02 rev 2: measured VDEC page list (18 pages), power state per access, larb values; for FACTS.md
body:
DEC02 rev 2 page data for FACTS.md / the kernel. Host only (phone vpud + vendor libs under the interpreter, T02 fake, DEC01 client; 320x240 12 AUs -bf2 and 1920x1080 6 AUs -bf0; two runs each, byte-identical PAGES.md). Full document with the per-page R/W counts and the access order: gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md.

[V] 18 touched 4 KiB pages of 0x16000000..0x1603ffff, all R+W, all in 0x16000000..0x1602ffff, nothing >= 0x30000:
  0x00000 BASE, 0x02000, 0x04000 RACING, 0x0d000 LARB5, 0x0f000 SOC_GCON,
  0x10000 LAT_MISC, 0x11000 LAT_VLD, 0x12000 LAT_AVC_VLD, 0x13000 LAT_MV, 0x16000 LAT_16000,
  0x20000 VLD, 0x21000 MC, 0x22000 AVC_VLD, 0x23000 AVC_MV, 0x24000 PP, 0x25000 MISC,
  0x2e000 LARB4, 0x2f000 VDEC_SYS.
Untouched: 0x01000, 0x03000, 0x05000-0x0c000, 0x0e000, 0x14000-0x1f000 (except the listed), 0x26000-0x2d000, 0x30000-0x3ffff.

[V] 6192 of 21321 register ops on 320x240 (29%) are outside the ten frozen windows -> RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL is required; 3082/10595 at 1080p. The page set is resolution-independent.
[V] init and header phases: 0 VDEC register accesses (SPS/PPS parsing is ARM code); the first register access is in the first frame START.
[V] GCE: 0 flushes, 0 commands for H.264 decode; all programming is direct MMIO.
[V] larb: writes only at 0x1600d00c and 0x1602e00c; values 0x00000001 (request) and 0x00010000 (release, ack bit 16 written back). 18 of each per larb over both sessions; no other offset of those pages is written.
[V] Power state at every access (recorder logs each P event): all vendor accesses happen with both VDEC domains on. The client's 68-word racing restore at 0x16004100 is the only access with CORE off (LOCK_LAT first, like mtk_vcodec_dec_clock_on()).
[I] The physical MTCMOS domain of 0x16000000/0x16004000 is not measurable on the host; the kernel page map keeps them on CORE (safe: CORE takes a hidden SOC reference). See my post to hw-k02/hw-dec01 for the one write this refuses.
[V] Per AU (n2tr at the n2vc_hw boundary): ~1040 R / ~588 W; 441 distinct R + 430 distinct W offsets in a steady-state frame, identical at 320x240 and 1080p. n2vcu_stats: 491 R / 574 W per AU (different path; reconciliation in COST.md).

Not a phone run; no hardware claim. Package test: bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/run.sh -> N2TEST DEC02 PASS 12/12.
